items.criterion: Uploaded bytes exist as an object in the declared bucket at the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Read the bucket after an upload and compare the key with the digest the upload reports.

items.criterion: A private tileset answers as not found to every caller but its owner, and publishing opens it.
items.judgment: Request one tile address with no token, another account's token and the owner's token.

items.criterion: A private tile is unreadable directly from the object store.
items.judgment: Request the tile object at the storage endpoint with no credential.

items.criterion: An upload reports an observable job state through to a terminal state.
items.judgment: Poll the upload resource until it reaches complete or failed.

items.criterion: A malformed source is refused and leaves no bytes and no tileset behind.
items.judgment: Send an unparseable source and compare the bucket listing before and after.

items.criterion: Identical bytes sent twice by one account resolve to one stored object.
items.judgment: Upload the same content twice and count the objects under the uploads prefix.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous operations on one style path leave exactly one winner.
items.judgment: Fire two version-carrying operations at one path at once.

items.criterion: Two operations on different paths both land and both appear in the history.
items.judgment: Commit one operation from each developer and read the operation history.

items.criterion: A published style is readable by reference with no session.
items.judgment: Publish a version and read the style address anonymously.

items.criterion: Every studio resource refuses a reader session.
items.judgment: Call each studio resource with a reader token.

items.criterion: Every studio resource refuses a caller with no token.
items.judgment: Call each studio resource with no Authorization header.

items.criterion: A token secret is readable exactly once, at creation.
items.judgment: Create a token, then read the token list and search for the secret.

items.criterion: A revoked token is refused while every other token on the account keeps working.
items.judgment: Revoke one of two tokens and call with each.

items.criterion: A token is refused at a service outside its scope, and the refusal names the scope.
items.judgment: Present a tiles-scoped token to the directions service.

items.criterion: A place in a private dataset is findable only by the owning account.
items.judgment: Add a named place and search for it as each account.

items.criterion: A movement read returns aggregated rows and no individual trace.
items.judgment: Read the movement product over the seeded area.

items.criterion: A matrix cell and the equivalent directions call agree.
items.judgment: Read one matrix cell and the matching route duration.

items.criterion: An isochrone returns one valid polygon per budget, each enclosing the smaller.
items.judgment: Request three budgets and compare the polygon areas.

items.criterion: Every billable action counts exactly one usage event.
items.judgment: Make three directions calls and compare the usage total before and after.

items.criterion: Seeding is idempotent across a restart.
items.judgment: Count the seeded tables, reseed and count again.

items.criterion: No credential or binary asset reaches the browser from a public route.
items.judgment: Fetch every marketing route and inspect the asset references.

items.criterion: Every record the app serves lives in the declared PostgreSQL database.
items.judgment: Count rows in each seeded table through the database adapter.
